sources.title: The Uttarakhand Tenancy Act, 2021
sources.publisher: Uttarakhand Urban Development Department, Government of Uttarakhand
sources.version: Act No. 02 of 2022; official Uttarakhand UDD copy listed 2025-12-29; commenced 2023-01-01 under Notification No. 67/iv(2)-sh.Vi.-2023-53 (sha)/2021 dated 2023-01-13
sources.verificationNote: Matched Act No. 02 of 2022 and the Act title against the official Uttarakhand Urban Development Department listing and linked PDF on 2026-11-04. Verified the section 1(3) commencement footnote in the official Uttarakhand Act PDF: the Act came into force on 2023-01-01 under Notification No. 67/iv(2)-sh.Vi.-2023-53 (sha)/2021 dated 2023-01-13. Case-specific applicability, statutory exceptions and the facts of any tenancy still require separate assessment.
sources.freshnessEvidence: Compared the current official Uttarakhand Urban Development Department listing and linked Act PDF (listed 2025-12-29) with the official Uttarakhand Act PDF containing the section 1(3) commencement footnote and the India Code Act copy. The official Uttarakhand PDF states that the whole Act came into force on 2023-01-01 vide Notification No. 67/iv(2)-sh.Vi.-2023-53 (sha)/2021 dated 2023-01-13. The official copies reviewed on 2026-11-04 agree on Act No. 02 of 2022 and the Act text; no later amending Act or amendment notification was identified in the official sources reviewed. This establishes statutory commencement and source-text currentness for the recorded Act snapshot only; case-specific applicability, exemptions under section 3, and any tenancy-specific procedural conditions remain unassessed. Official commencement-bearing Uttarakhand Act PDF: https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3bc7f621451b4f5df308a8e098112185d/uploads/2025/03/202503251012941681.pdf. Official India Code Act PDF: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/20015/1/uk_tenancy_act%2C_2021_eng.pdf. Current UDD document listing: https://udd.uk.gov.in/document/uttarakhand-tenancy-act-2021/.

sources.title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019
sources.version: Act No. 35 of 2019; India Code record 123456789/16103
sources.verificationNote: Act ID 201935, Act No. 35, enactment date 2019-08-09 and title matched against the official India Code record. The Department of Consumer Affairs page lists the Act and separate commencement notifications. This verifies source identity only; amendments, provision-level commencement and currentness require separate review.
sources.freshnessEvidence: Compared the local curated Consumer Protection Act source and its provision summaries with the official India Code Act PDF (arrangement page states last updated 17-09-2021) and the Mediation Act, 2023 (Act No. 32 of 2023), Tenth Schedule, published 15-09-2023 in Gazette ID CG-DL-E-15092023-248775 (https://egazette.gov.in/WriteReadData/2023/248775.pdf), the official India Code Mediation Act consolidation (https://upload.indiacode.nic.in/view-casepdf?id=AC_CEN_3_46_00011_A2023-32_1697800640677&type=act), and the Mediation (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 2023, S.O. 4506(E) (https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s316026d60ff9b54410b3435b403afd226/uploads/2024/07/20240719744521243.pdf). The Tenth Schedule specifies changes to Consumer Protection Act sections 2(25) and 2(26), section 37 (including new sections 37A and 37B), section 38(1), section 41, Chapter V, and delegated rule/regulation powers; S.O. 4506(E) dated 13-10-2023 further changes the section 37 wording. The local curated source still reflects the 2021 Act text and does not reconcile these later amendment texts or their applicable commencement scope. The seed provisions are sections 2(10), 2(11) and 39(1)(c), which are not the provisions expressly changed in the Tenth Schedule, but source-level currentness is not established until the complete consolidation and commencement status are reviewed. Marked stale; preserved the prior retrievedAt and version.

sources.title: The Code on Wages, 2019
sources.version: India Code consolidated text as on 2025-11-21; Act No. 29 of 2019; India Code Act ID 201929; staged commencement includes S.O. 5322(E) for specified provisions
sources.verificationNote: Act ID 201929, Act No. 29, enactment date 2019-08-08 and title matched against the official India Code record. Gazette S.O. 5322(E) dated 2025-11-21 commences only its listed provisions; no blanket commencement date is inferred.
sources.freshnessEvidence: Compared the India Code consolidated Code on Wages PDF labelled as on 21 November 2025 (https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/15793/1/aA2019-29.pdf) with Gazette S.O. 454(E), dated 30 January 2026 (https://egazette.gov.in/WriteReadData/2026/269705.pdf). The Gazette sets the supervisory-worker wage ceiling at ₹18,000 per month under section 2(z)(d), while the stored 2025 consolidated text still states ₹15,000. Marked stale pending a refreshed snapshot and review of affected provisions.
